name: Custom Shape 4-Layer Wooden Photo Frame
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a warm, elegant, and meaningful display finish.
    - Features a 4-layer wooden construction that creates a dimensional, eye-catching, and premium decorative effect.
    - Each layer has a thickness of ~5mm, providing sturdy support and a solid handcrafted feel.
    - Total thickness is 2 cm ~ 0.79 in, making the frame stable for tabletop display.
    - Supports printing of up to 3 photos, allowing for a more personal and memorable keepsake.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1 supports 2-sided printing, while Layer 2, Layer 3, and Layer 4 support 1-sided printing for a rich layered design.
    - Supports personalized printing with up to 3 custom photos.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a personalized photo frame and meaningful decorative keepsake.
    - Designed for tabletop display on desks, shelves, side tables, or memory corners.
    - Layered wooden structure creates a 3D visual effect that enhances photos and custom artwork.
    - Perfect for displaying family moments, parent-child memories, or heartfelt messages.
    - Suitable for home décor, office décor, and personalized gift display.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for dads, moms, grandparents, family members, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, and family celebrations.
    - Ideal for memorial keepsakes, appreciation gifts, and emotional photo displays.
    - A thoughtful gift for preserving treasured family moments and heartfelt memories.
    - Great for holiday gifting, special milestones, and meaningful surprise presents.
    - Adds a warm, loving, and personal touch to any space 🎁 🎁🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 xCustom Shape 4-Layer Wooden Photo Frame

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
